title: The run step's check tightening after the research story keeps an item's other checks and replaces its clause mapping
goal: skills/sprint/SKILL.md's run-step paragraph on rerunning precheck after the goal research story says to pass every check of the item again to set ID --check (which replaces the whole list) and to map the clauses with --clause (which replaces the mapping), not --add-clause, so a multi-check item keeps its other checks and no clause stays mapped to a stale index (SP-ce5iig4g review: skills/sprint/SKILL.md:58)

run: import sys;t=open('skills/sprint/SKILL.md',encoding='utf-8').read();s=t.split('## run [SP]',1)[1].split('\n## ',1)[0];ok=any('tighten' in l and '--clause' in l.replace('--add-clause','') for l in s.splitlines());print('run step tightens with --clause:',ok);sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)
